value.rationale: The exact first nonzero defect of a 2010 Delannoy congruence, proven only to modulus n³ in 2025, is a natural higher-order arithmetic question. The theorem gives a sharp n⁴/2 cutoff and r-1 extra binary digits for every increasing dyadic scale, not a finite numerical recomputation or a solution falsely attributed to an already-resolved conjecture. The adjacent-value valuation isolates a meaningful structural source of the improvement.
